The whole excursion is supposed to last between six and six and a half hours. It is only the sixth all-female excursion in space history.

articles.title: Tunisia's iconic Sidi Bou Said town added to UNESCO world heritage list
articles.description: In Tunisia, UNESCO recognised the town of Sidi Bou Said as a world heritage site this July. The designation marks a new period in the cultural preservation of this historic tourist site. The special status may help as it battles erosion, like in the floods this last January, but it will also help boost its lesser known Sufi mystical traditions.
